Arthur.day_scenario: Arthur rises at 6:00 AM to tend to his vegetable garden before the sun is fully up, carefully weeding the herb patch and checking the drip irrigation. He spends the afternoon relaxing at the kitchen table with a historical non-fiction book on Roman engineering, later enjoying a silent evening to wind down before sleeping at 10:00 PM.

Martha.day_scenario: Martha wakes at 6:30 AM to enjoy her morning crossword puzzles with a steaming cup of Earl Grey tea. Since it is Friday, she stays home to organize her knitting supplies and later slips into bed to write in her small journal by the bed for evening reflections before going to sleep at 10:30 PM.
